game.name: Geometry Dash
game.rules:
These rules are in addition to the ones found in the **"Category Rules"** section:

PC runs **must** use the [autosplitter](https://www.speedrun.com/gmd/guide/lg6k8) to obtain a loadless time in the Classic categories. It is **strongly recommended** for obtaining the in-game time for Platformer categories.

# Proof

**All runs must have video proof that contains game audio.**

All **top 3** submissions **MUST** provide **ONE** or more of the following:

- **Audible key / button presses**
- **Hand cam**

Additionally, **top 3** submissions in **platformer** categories must provide the **entire, unedited video** that the run came from, either by including it in the description of the submission or sending it privately to one of the moderators.

(If a category has less than 3 players, the above additional rules only apply to world record submissions in that category)

(Effective 10/27/2020): All 2.1 PC submissions are required to show an FPS counter
(see https://www.speedrun.com/gmd/guide/e6ay2 on how to get it to show in OBS).

# Allowed Mega Hack Settings:

**2.1 -** https://www.speedrun.com/gmd/guide/mxttx

**2.2 - Enabling any settings outside of the Bypass, Mega Hack, and Creator sections is not allowed, aside from V-Sync and Fullscreen.**

# Mods:

(Effective 02/17/2024): **All mods are banned for runs.** Geode and other mod menus are allowed to be installed, but all mods must be disabled prior to starting a run. Runs that use mods will be rejected.

# **General Rules:** 

Levels may be completed in any order, aside from The Tower and the Secret Coin restrictions present in the 1-14, 1-18, 1-21, and 1-22 categories.

Time starts on the first frame the icon appears in the first attempt of the first level and ends on the first frame of the explosion upon completion of the last level, aside from runs of The Tower.

2.1 and below - The FPS bypass hack and monitor FPS tricking (piepass) are both allowed. However, your FPS must be set to 360 FPS or below (highest FPS currently available on a retail monitor). FPS must be capped at the same value throughout the run, unless you are running All Map Packs.

2.2 and above - Any reasonable FPS value set in-game is allowed since the physics are consistent amongst all refresh rates. However, you cannot speed up the game by increasing the FPS cap to an extremely high value.

Switching out any of the in-game music is banned. It is also preferred that any enabled texture packs only modify the player icons.

One-to-one remapping of keyboard inputs is allowed.

categories.rules:
Complete all levels on a specified floor of the tower. You must complete the levels in order. You must have the "Show Time" option enabled. You must go from level to level in a timely fashion. You cannot pause for an excessive amount of time during the run. Game audio is required.

Load Removed Time is determined by adding together the In-Game Times displayed at the end of each level. If a death is taken that resets the timer, the time for that attempt is also factored in.

RTA time begins the frame that the in-game timer starts on the first level and ends the frame that the timer freezes on the last level.

Use "Classic Mode" with the autosplitter for this category: [https://www.speedrun.com/gmd/guide/lg6k8](https://www.speedrun.com/gmd/guide/lg6k8)

Please see Game Rules for additional rules.

Complete all of the levels in every single Map Pack.

You are allowed to change your FPS cap in-between levels.

Break Rules

For every 6 hours of gameplay, you are allowed to take a break for up to 8 hours.  
To confirm that your breaks are of the proper length, please either record your system clock at the start of each part, or enable the setting in Mega Hack that shows the current time while playing levels.

2.1 and below - The FPS bypass hack and monitor FPS tricking (piepass) are both allowed. However, your FPS must be set to 360 FPS or below (highest FPS currently available on a retail monitor). FPS must be capped at the same value throughout the run, unless you are running All Map Packs.

2.2 and above - Any reasonable FPS value set in-game is allowed since the physics are consistent amongst all refresh rates. However, you cannot speed up the game by increasing the FPS cap to an extremely high value.

Switching out any of the in-game music is banned. It is also preferred that any enabled texture packs only modify the player icons.

One-to-one remapping of keyboard inputs is allowed.

values.rules:
Complete a specified number of moon-rated platformer levels of any difficulty. You can complete the levels that you select in any order. You must have the "Show Time" option enabled. You must go from level to level in a timely fashion. You cannot pause for an excessive amount of time during the run. Game audio is required.

Load Removed Time is determined by adding together the In-Game Times displayed at the end of each level. If a death is taken that resets the timer, the time for that attempt is also factored in.

RTA time begins the frame that the in-game timer starts on the first level and ends the frame that the timer freezes on the last level.
